 Kevin Durant’s Arizona House in Photos
 The former Phoenix Suns forward is selling his desert-modern residence in Paradise Valley for $14 million. 
 Published on November 18, 2026 
 By Wendy Bowman

 The home offers five bedrooms, seven full bathrooms, and a powder room in roughly 10,900 square feet across a single level. Click here for the full story .
